title: Homesite Reservation Funding: Required Funds, Payment Methods and the Funding Deadline
content:
## Required funds

The required funds for a Homesite Reservation are the class's reservation deposit plus the class's premium holding fee. For each premium class, from Interior Homesite to Golf-Frontage Homesite, the reservation deposit, the premium holding fee and the deposit due days used in this rule are that class's own figures.

## Payments

1. Each payment must use a method listed among the class's accepted payment methods. Once the reservation has had the class's number of returned payments after which only wire or certified funds are accepted (counting every returned payment over the life of the reservation), only wire or certified funds are accepted.
2. A card payment may not exceed the class's largest single card payment. It carries a card convenience fee of the class's card convenience fee percent of the card amount, rounded half up to the cent, booked as its own card convenience fee component. The card convenience fee does not count toward the required funds and is never refunded.
3. Payments are applied first to the reservation deposit and then to the premium holding fee.
4. The clause "the hold is activated on the day the deposit and premium holding fee components together reach the required funds" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current activation basis.

## Funding deadline

The required funds must be received within the class's deposit due days, in calendar days after the reservation date. Counting starts the day after the reservation date, and the hold may be activated through the end of the last counted day. If the funds are not complete by then, the system expires the reservation and any partial funds are refunded under the release refund rules with the refund reason hold expired. The deadline is judged from the reservation date on the reservation record and the posting dates of the payments on the reservation ledger.

## Worked example (hypothetical class figures: deposit 2500.00, premium holding fee 500.00, card accepted with a largest single card payment of 2500.00, deposit due days 2)

- Required funds: 2500.00 plus 500.00, which is 3000.00.
- The buyer pays 2000.00 by ACH, then 1000.00 by card. The ACH payment is applied to the reservation deposit; of the card payment, 500.00 completes the reservation deposit and 500.00 goes to the premium holding fee.
- The card convenience fee is 2.75 percent of 1000.00 in this example, 27.50, booked as its own component and not counted toward the 3000.00.

## Deadline boundary (same hypothetical, reservation date 10 June)

| Date the funds become complete | Day count after the reservation date | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 12 June | day 2, the last counted day | the hold may be activated through the end of 12 June |
| Not complete at the end of 12 June | past the last counted day | the system expires the reservation; partial funds are refunded with the reason hold expired |

superseded_clauses: The hold is activated on the day the deposit and premium holding fee components together reach the required funds.
